eyebrow: A real governance voting interface -- Tally
caption: Voting power shown above the proposal, with For, Against, and Abstain as the three options.
Voting power is registered and verified against a snapshot, not read live at vote time.

eyebrow: Aave governance v3 -- representative voting flow
caption: A participant chooses a representative, who submits votes on their behalf -- tokens never move.
Delegation hands off voting weight, never custody of the tokens themselves.

subtitle: The safeguards between a vote passing and funds actually moving.
